description: Pickup timestamp is required for period assignment, duration calculation, and hourly demand analysis.
condition: tpep_pickup_datetime IS NULL

description: Drop-off timestamp is required for valid trip duration.
condition: tpep_dropoff_datetime IS NULL

description: A trip cannot end before it begins.
condition: tpep_dropoff_datetime < tpep_pickup_datetime

description: The analytical source period is 2025, so pickup timestamps outside [2025-01-01, 2026-01-01) are invalid for this pipeline.
condition: tpep_pickup_datetime < '2025-01-01' OR tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2026-01-01'

description: Pickup and drop-off location IDs are required for zone enrichment and zone-based analytics.
condition: PULocationID IS NULL OR DOLocationID IS NULL

description: An exact duplicate source row beyond the first occurrence would double-count trips and revenue.
condition: complete-source-record SHA-256 hash occurs more than once; quarantine duplicate occurrence(s) beyond the first

description: Trip distance cannot be physically negative.
condition: trip_distance < 0

description: Negative fares are suspicious but occur at material scale; profiling alone does not justify rejecting all such records.
condition: fare_amount < 0
rationale: Observed 2,848,620 records. Blanket quarantine would be unjustified without business evidence.

description: Negative total amounts require business interpretation and should be flagged rather than silently rejected.
condition: total_amount < 0

description: Very large fares require review before any hard upper-bound rejection rule is adopted.
condition: fare_amount >= 900

description: Very long trips may be legitimate or erroneous; profiling threshold is for investigation only.
condition: trip_distance >= 150

description: Trips lasting at least 10 hours require review; duration alone is not sufficient for automatic rejection.
condition: (tpep_dropoff_datetime - tpep_pickup_datetime) >= 10 hours

description: Non-positive or unusually high passenger counts are suspicious but may reflect source coding or reporting behavior.
condition: passenger_count <= 0 OR passenger_count > 6

description: Required Taxi columns or compatible data types must be present before processing.
condition: required Taxi column missing OR required column type incompatible with expected schema
rationale: No monthly schema differences were observed in 2025; rule protects incremental loads.

description: created_date is required to place a complaint in the 2025 analysis period.
condition: created_date IS NULL OR created_date cannot be parsed

description: The 311 dataset is scoped by complaint creation date to calendar year 2025.
condition: created_date < '2025-01-01' OR created_date >= '2026-01-01'

description: A complaint cannot logically close before it is created.
condition: closed_date IS NOT NULL AND closed_date < created_date

description: unique_key is the business identifier and must not produce duplicate complaint records downstream.
condition: unique_key duplicated; quarantine duplicate occurrence(s) beyond the first

description: Latitude and longitude are required for point-in-polygon enrichment to Taxi Zones.
condition: latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL
rationale: Observed 50,148 records; these cannot participate reliably in spatial enrichment.

description: Coordinates outside global latitude/longitude ranges are structurally invalid.
condition: latitude < -90 OR latitude > 90 OR longitude < -180 OR longitude > 180

description: Resolution times longer than 365 days require investigation but are not automatically invalid.
condition: closed_date IS NOT NULL AND closed_date - created_date > 365 days

description: Required 311 fields must exist before downstream processing.
condition: required 311 field missing OR incompatible schema prevents parsing
rationale: No monthly field-set differences were observed in 2025; rule protects incremental loads.

description: The 2025 hourly weather series must have one observation for every expected hour.
condition: expected hourly timestamp absent from 2025 hourly grid
rationale: Observed 0 missing hours across 8,760 expected timestamps.

description: Duplicate weather timestamps would create one-to-many joins against hour-grain analytical data.
condition: hourly timestamp occurs more than once

description: Physically impossible weather measurements must not enter analytical joins.
condition: humidity < 0 OR humidity > 100 OR precipitation < 0 OR rain < 0 OR snowfall < 0 OR wind_speed_10m < 0 OR wind_gusts_10m < 0
rationale: Observed 0 records for all profiled physical-range checks.

description: Weather timestamps must remain on the expected 2025 hourly grid.
All required hourly variables and equal-length arrays must be present for each month.
condition: required hourly key missing OR hourly arrays have inconsistent lengths

description: LocationID is required as the natural key for Taxi Zone enrichment.
condition: LocationID IS NULL

description: LocationID must be unique to prevent ambiguous zone joins.
condition: LocationID occurs more than once

description: A populated zone label is required for reporting and dimensional enrichment.
condition: Zone is empty after preserving literal source values such as 'N/A'
rationale: Observed 0 true missing zone names after keep_default_na=False.

description: TLC special reference values such as Unknown, N/A, and Outside of NYC are valid source labels and must not be converted to nulls.
condition: LocationID in known special-reference rows such as 264 or 265

description: Expected Taxi Zone lookup columns must be present before enrichment.
condition: schema differs from LocationID, Borough, Zone, service_zone
